deathSays.line: ★ IDENTIFIED: Peanut. Groundnut. Low bush, nuts buried under it. Dig them up. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
◈ The Records: The village drew first blood: Sunback is dead. It is written.

🌙 Raid — Stonebridge came in the night from the northwest. They carried off ~1050 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
📻 "Why do the small humans keep putting organic matter in their FACE-HOLES? We built you a fusion pellet! ...You BURIED it. WHY did you bury the pellet?!"
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Nevermore is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

🔥 The fire settles. Paola has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Karl breathes "Tell me you didn't go alone." Sofia says "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
